edits.new: 1783年12月22日，星期一，大陆会议议定了第二天公开接见总司令乔治·华盛顿的次序。难处不在打仗，而在收场：一个统帅军队的人要当众把受托的权力交回一个坐着开会的机构，这个场面里谁坐着、谁站着、谁鞠躬、谁脱帽，本身就在说话。国会为此把接见的动作逐条写定。
edits.reason: Review: Annapolis, 'war over' and 'first thing' were unsupported.

edits.new: On Monday, 22 December 1783, the Continental Congress settled the order of the next day's public audience with its commander-in-chief, George Washington. The hard part was not the fighting but the ending. A man who had commanded armies was about to hand delegated power back in public, to a body that did its business sitting down, and in a scene like that, who sits, who stands, who bows and who lifts a hat all speak for themselves. So Congress wrote the movements of the audience down, item by item.
